title: The County Governments in Kenya
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Teach the structure as two boxes: the executive does, the assembly makes laws and checks. Name offices, never office holders or parties.

skills.key_step: The child places offices in the two parts of a county government: the executive (Governor, Deputy Governor, county executive committee) and the assembly (MCAs, Speaker).

floor.prerequisite: Knows the county is made of sub-counties and wards.
floor.question: What is the smallest of these: county, ward, sub-county?

representations: a county assembly photo without names
steps: Draw the executive box and the assembly box.
The executive carries out the work: Governor, Deputy, executive committee.
The assembly makes county laws and checks the executive: MCAs and the Speaker.
contexts: the county assembly meeting on a new market law
the Governor opening a health centre
an executive committee member for agriculture

board.do: Draw two boxes: county executive and county assembly.
Write MCAs and the Speaker in the assembly; Governor, Deputy and committee in the executive.

misconceptions.ask: Who is in the county executive?
misconceptions.repair: Make two columns: national and county, and place each leader.

misconceptions.ask: Which one is a member of the county assembly?
misconceptions.repair: Draw two boxes: executive, assembly; place each person.

listen_for: Yes, the Governor is the county government
misconceptions.ask: Is the county government only the Governor?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the two boxes and fill them with all the people in each.

misconceptions.ask: Is the Speaker of the County Assembly part of the county executive?
misconceptions.repair: Put the Speaker's card in the assembly box and say what the Speaker does there.

checks.question: Name the two parts of a county government.
checks.answer: the county executive and the county assembly

checks.question: In which part is the Governor?

skills.key_step: The child says the Governor is elected by the county for five years, heads the executive and carries out county laws, but does not make them.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the two parts of a county government.
floor.question: Which part of the county government makes county laws?

representations: a duty sort: Governor or not
a timeline of a five-year term
a news story about a county project
steps: Say how long the term is.
Name what the Governor does not do: make laws, head the country.
contexts: the Governor opening a new road
the Governor naming the executive committee
the Governor reporting to the county assembly

board.do: Write three duties: makes county laws, heads the county executive, heads the country.
Wait for heads the county executive.
Write who does the other two: county assembly; the President.

misconceptions.repair: Ask: who makes the rules at school and who sees they are followed?

misconceptions.ask: The Governor is head of which?
misconceptions.repair: Place the Governor and the President on a map of Kenya: which area does each lead?

misconceptions.ask: How long is a Governor's term?
misconceptions.repair: Show the general election cycle: every five years.

misconceptions.ask: Who chooses the Governor of a county?
misconceptions.repair: Ask who votes in the county at a general election.

checks.question: Does the Governor make county laws?
checks.answer: No: the county assembly does; the Governor carries them out

skills.key_step: The child says an MCA is elected by a ward, makes county laws, approves the budget, checks the executive and speaks for the ward.

floor.prerequisite: Knows a ward is part of a sub-county.
floor.question: Name the smallest unit of the county.

representations: a ward map of an imaginary county
a role play of an assembly debate
steps: Say who elects the MCA: the ward.
Name the duties: makes laws, approves the budget, checks the executive.
Say whom the MCA speaks for: the ward.
Say what the MCA does not do: build roads personally.
contexts: an MCA asking for a borehole for the ward
the assembly passing a market law

board.do: Draw a county split into wards with one ward shaded.

board.say: Who speaks for this ward in the county assembly?

board.do: Write the MCA's duties beside it.

misconceptions.repair: Ask who writes the plan and who builds the road.
Mark a ward on a sketch and name the MCA.

misconceptions.ask: Who chooses the Member of the County Assembly for a ward?
misconceptions.repair: Name what is on the ballot at a general election, including the MCA.
Act a budget: the executive proposes, the MCAs debate and vote.

checks.question: Who does an MCA speak for?
Give one role of an MCA.
checks.answer: any of: makes county laws, approves the budget, checks the executive, speaks for the ward
